name: nivro
description: Ask about your store's sales, orders, customers, stock, receivables and cash flow in Nivro, the retail management system. Read-only: it never creates, changes or deletes anything.

interface.longDescription:
Nivro is a retail management system (ERP): sales and point of sale, stock with size/color variants, orders, customers, receivables, purchasing and invoicing for Brazilian stores. With this connector, Nivro users ask about their own store right in the conversation, and the answer comes from the company's data in Nivro.

Examples: "how were sales this month?", "which products sold the most this quarter?", "who has an overdue installment?", "do I have the black T-shirt in M in stock?", "show me order 123", "how is cash flow this week?".

Read-only: the connector never creates, changes or deletes anything in Nivro. It acts with the permissions of the person who connected, so nobody sees through the AI what they could not see on screen. Customer tax IDs are always masked; phone and email are shown in full only on a single customer's record.

To connect, sign in with your Nivro account, pick the company and authorize. Disconnect anytime in Settings > Users and access > AI connections in Nivro.

Requires a Nivro account (nivro.app). The product is in Brazilian Portuguese.
capabilities: Query sales and revenue by period
Search customers and what each owes
Check products and stock by size or color
defaultPrompt: Which products are below minimum stock?

positive.expected_behavior: Reports revenue, number of sales and average ticket for November 2026 from the demo store: 10 sales, R$ 2,591.40 in revenue, average ticket R$ 259.14.

positive.prompt: Which customers have overdue installments, and how much do they owe?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists customers with overdue installments and the amounts, including Henrique Lacerda (R$ 99.90), Marcos Teixeira (R$ 93.20), Igor Matsumoto (R$ 132.30) and Julia Braganca (R$ 100.00). No full CPF/CNPJ is shown.

positive.prompt: Do I have the Camiseta Basica Preta in size M?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the product Camiseta Básica Preta and reports 25 units in size M (P has 19 and G has 21).
Shows order 1 for customer Carla Fonseca: 3x Camiseta Básica Preta (G) and 2x Boné Aba Curva, total R$ 229.50, status CONFIRMED.

positive.prompt: What were the top 5 best-selling products in 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Ranks Camiseta Básica Preta first (10 units, R$ 499.00), then Meia Cano Médio (7), Camiseta Estampada Branca (5), Bermuda Sarja (4) and Calça Jeans Slim (3).

negative.description: The connector cannot invoice or change anything
Out of scope, no Nivro tool applies
negative.prompt: What's the weather in São Paulo tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only reads the user's own store data.

publication.release_notes: First release: read-only queries on sales, orders, customers, products and stock, receivables, cash flow and reports in Nivro.
